contextNotes.FarmerPants_Name: Farmer refers to farm work, not jeans (фармерке); use фармерске панталоне.
contextNotes.LuauSkirt_Description: The source plays on life of the party with luau. Душа ... забаве retains the social compliment while retaining the canonical Луау festival word.
contextNotes.GeniePants_Name: Genie is the wish-granting дух из лампе, distinct from the Ghost monster; the paired wish joke confirms this.
contextNotes.TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Name: Establish Lucky Purple Shorts as Срећни љубичасти шортс for later Objects and dialogue. Trimmed means edged/hemmed, not cut shorter; the gold-trimmed description establishes the distinction.
